data.text: Once per turn: a Shrine rises on the free (unoccupied) hex within 2 hexes that you pick; if you pick none (or it is not free), on a random free hex within 2 hexes. One Shrine per Priest stands at a time: a new one replaces the old. Whoever stands on your Shrine at the end of a turn (its 3rd action) heals 2 life, never above their maximum (a copy of it heals 1).
